name: Lucky St. Pat's Day Cookies with Chocolate Chips and Marshmallows

ingredients.name: Lucky Charms frosted toasted oat cereal with marshmallows

instructions.primary_message: This recipe contains steps that can be done by smaller hands! You know your child (and their cooking abilities) best, so get them involved where you feel comfortable. Have fun!
Cut butter into small pieces, place in a medium bowl, and set aside to soften, 20 minutes.
Meanwhile, pour Lucky Charms into a large bowl (or two!). Have fun picking out 1 ½-cups of the marshmallows, then set aside. Reserve remaining cereal and marshmallows for another use.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 (10.5 oz) box Lucky Charms frosted toasted oat cereal with marshmallows

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 350°F. Line two large baking sheet pans with parchment paper. (Or work in batches if necessary.)
Place flour, cream of tartar, baking powder, baking soda, and salt in another medium bowl, whisk to combine, and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups all-purpose flour
1 tsp cream of tartar
1 tsp baking powder
½ tsp baking soda
¼ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Once the butter is softened, add sugar to the bowl, then beat with a hand-held electric mixer until combined and fluffy, about 3 minutes. Scrape down the sides of the bowl with a silicone spatula.

Add egg, vanilla, and food coloring, then beat once more to combine, scraping down the sides of the bowl as needed. Add the flour mixture and stir well to combine the cookie dough. (If needed, add additional food coloring, one drop at a time, to reach desired color.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 egg
1 tsp vanilla extract
8 drop green food coloring

instructions.primary_message: Add reserved marshmallows and chocolate chips to the bowl with the cookie dough, then stir once more to combine.
Working with a generous tablespoon of dough at a time, roll into balls and arrange on the baking sheets, spacing them about 2 inches apart.

Place baking sheets in the preheated oven and bake until golden around the edges, about 10 minutes. Remove from oven and let cool on the baking sheets for 2 minutes before transferring to a cooling rack to cool completely.
Arrange cookies on a platter, share, and enjoy!
